promotions.body:
## Cadance 7 is available
A free update with a Teacher Notebook, one search, and folder imports.

- **Teacher Notebook**: typed and handwritten class notes that link to your tracks
- **Search**: one search across your music, Syllabus, playlists and Apple Music
- **Import Music**: bring in whole folders from Files and iCloud Drive
- **Visual Tour**: a new guided walkthrough

Your playlists and passes stay as they are.
promotions.headline: Update available

promotions.body:
## Welcome!
Keep an eye out for new playlists to be highlighted here!

### Where do the playlists live?
You can find them on the Music Playlists tab under Cadance Resources.

## Cadance 4: What's new:
- Day Passes are here, great alternative to subscriptions
- 33 curated playlists pre-installed, including music for Extraordinary Groups and kids' Hip-hop
- Explore any artist or album catalog instantly from within the app
- iPad Bluetooth remote with large studio-scale overlay
- Teacher Lock to prevent accidental screen taps during class
- Enhanced Apple Watch control

### What has changed:
The free tier is now Class Planning mode — unlimited playlist editing with 15-second previews of any track, including Apple Music. Activate a Day Pass or subscribe when it is time to teach.

Need more Day Passes? They are now available for purchase in-app.
promotions.headline: What’s new in Favorites

promotions.body:
## Day Pass: What is it?
The perfect alternative to subscriptions, each one gives you full, unrestricted access until midnight on the day you activate it.

## They never expire
Use them only on the days you teach. Also works as a temporary upgrade to your subscription!

## Need more Day Passes?
They are available for purchase in-app.
promotions.headline: Starting a Day Pass

promotions.body:
## Need Help?
For quick feature demos see the focused tips at the link below.
promotions.headline: Feature help

promotions.body:
## Start your Day Pass on your terms
Look for the banner 'Activate your Day Pass' on your first track play - you'll have 10 seconds to stop activation.

If you stop activation, all tracks played after that will be in Preview mode and reset after 15 seconds.

## Ready to teach?
Go to Settings (gear icon at the top of the app), scroll to the Day Passes section, and select Activate a Day Pass Now.

## Need more Day Passes?
They are now available for purchase from the Day Passes section on our Settings screen.
promotions.headline: Starting a Day Pass
